56700.commentary: (VINa) saṅketakamman'ti sañjānanakammaṃ, kālaparicchedavasena saññāṇakaraṇan'ti attho. ettha ca purebhattaṃ avaharā'ti vutte ajja vā purebhattaṃ avaharatu, sve vā, anāgate vā saṃvacchare, n'atthi visaṅketo, ubhinnam'pi ocarake vuttanayen'eva pārājikaṃ.

examples.text: saṅketakammaṃ nāma saṅketaṃ karoti, purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā rattiṃ vā divā vā tena saṅketena taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharā'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. tena saṅketena taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharati, āpatti ubhinnaṃ pārājikassa.

56705.commentary: (ANa) aṭavisaṅkopo'ti aṭaviyā saṅkopo. aṭavī'ti c'ettha aṭavivāsino corā veditabbā. yadā hi te aṭavito janapadaṃ otaritvā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo paharitvā vilumpanti, tadā aṭavisaṅkopo nāma hoti, taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho asamayo padhānāya.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni
ratanaṃ nāma muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavālaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohit'aṅko masāragallaṃ.

56707.meaning1: (comm) name of a long rooted aquatic plant

56709.meaning1: name of a mythological future king

examples.text: asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ketumatiyā rājadhāniyā saṅkho nāma rājā uppajjissati cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.

56710.meaning2: who is suffering with white crab

56712.meaning2: conditioned, prepared, produced by a cause
56712.commentary: (SNa) saṅkhatan'ti paccayehi samāgantvā kataṃ. (THa) saṅkhatā'ti samecca sambhuyya paccayehi katā.

examples.text: tañ'ca kho saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ. etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ upekkhā'ti
pakappitā saṅkhatā yassa dhammā, purakkhatā santi avīvadātā, yadattani passati ānisaṃsaṃ, taṃ nissito kuppapaṭicca santiṃ.

56713.meaning1: fact of being created; state of being conditioned; fact of being fabricated
56713.construction:
saṃ + √kar > khar + ta + tta
saṅkhata + tta

56714.meaning1: creates the created; produces the produced; fabricates the fabricated (for)
56714.commentary: (SNa) rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharontī'ti yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati nāma, evaṃ paccayehi samāgantvā katabhāvena saṅkhatan'ti laddhanāmaṃ rūpam'eva rūpattāya yathā abhisaṅkhataṃ rūpaṃ nāma hoti, tath'attāya rūpabhāvāya abhisaṅkharoti āyūhati sampiṇḍeti, nipphādetī'ti attho.

examples.text: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti. saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharontī'ti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā saṅkhārā'ti vuccati.

56715.meaning1: quality of the constructed; characteristic of the fabricated; mark of the conditioned

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇāni. katamāni tīṇi? uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī'ti.

56716.meaningLit: discourse on qualities of the constructed

examples.text: dve imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, saṅkhatādhātu, asaṅkhatādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, dve dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

56719.meaning1: based on the conditioned; founded on the fabricated
56719.commentary: (ANa) saṅkhat'ārammaṇā'ti paccayanibbattaṃ saṅkhatadhammaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā'va uppajjanti. no asaṅkhat'ārammaṇā'ti asaṅkhataṃ pana nibbānaṃ ārabbha na uppajjanti.

examples.text: saṅkhat'ārammaṇā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no asaṅkhat'ārammaṇā. tass'eva saṅkhatassa pahānā evaṃ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī'ti.
yā kāci, bhante, saṅkhatiyo sabbā tā rattiṃ, appā divā.
seyyathā'pi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasiren'eva catuddisā viññāpeyya, evam'eva kho evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.
saṅkho ca paṇavo ca saṅkhapaṇavaṃ, gītañ'ca vāditañ'ca gītavāditaṃ, daddari ca ḍiṇḍimo ca daddariḍiṇḍimaṃ. evaṃ tūriy'aṅg'atthe.

56728.meaning1: sound of conches, cymbals and tom-toms
56728.meaning2: sound of conches, cymbals and tom-toms

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so suṇeyya bherisaddam'pi mudiṅgasaddam'pi saṅkhapaṇavadindimasaddam'pi. tassa evam'assa, bherisaddo iti'pi, mudiṅgasaddo iti'pi, saṅkhapaṇavadindimasaddo iti'pi.

56729.meaning1: sound of conches, cymbals and tom-toms
56729.meaning2: sound of conches, cymbals and tom-toms

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so suṇeyya bherisaddam'pi mutiṅgasaddam'pi saṅkhapaṇavadeṇḍimasaddam'pi.

56731.commentary: (MNa) saṅkhamuṇḍikan'ti saṅkhamuṇḍakammakāraṇaṃ, taṃ karontā uttar'oṭṭha-ubhato-kaṇṇa-cūḷika-gaḷavāṭa-paricchedena cammaṃ chinditvā sabbakese ekato gaṇṭhiṃ katvā daṇḍakena vallitvā uppāṭenti, saha kesehi cammaṃ uṭṭhahati. tato sīsakaṭāhaṃ thūlasakkharāhi ghaṃsitvā dhovantā saṅkhavaṇṇaṃ karonti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… bilaṅgathālikam'pi karonti, saṅkhamuṇḍikam'pi karonti, rāhumukham'pi karonti, jotimālikam'pi karonti, hatthapajjotikam'pi karonti, erakavattikam'pi karonti

56732.commentary: (DNa) taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā'ti taṇhāsaṅkhayo'ti maggo'pi nibbānam'pi. maggo taṇhaṃ saṅkhiṇāti vināsetī'ti taṇhāsaṅkhayo. nibbānaṃ yasmā taṃ āgamma taṇhā saṅkhiyati vinassati, tasmā taṇhāsaṅkhayo. taṇhāsaṅkhayena maggena vimuttā, taṇhāsaṅkhaye nibbāne vimuttā adhimuttā'ti taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā. (SNa) taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā'ti taṇhāsaṅkhaye nibbāne tadārammaṇāya phalavimuttiyā vimuttā.

examples.text: suciṇṇaṃ brahmacariyaṃ me, maggo c'āpi subhāvito, maraṇe me bhayaṃ n'atthi, rogānam'iva saṅkhaye.
kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti

56736.meaning2: having restored, having prepared, having put together

examples.text: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkharitvā ajjhoharanti.

56738.meaning1: puts together; composes; fashions; fabricates; concocts

56741.meaning1: binding with chains; bondage with fetters

examples.text: bandheyyuṃ vā'ti rajjubandhanena vā andubandhanena vā saṅkhalikabandhanena vā gharabandhanena vā nagarabandhanena vā gāmabandhanena vā nigamabandhanena vā bandheyyuṃ, purisaguttiṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ
sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā. na'y'idaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ek'antaparipuṇṇaṃ ek'antaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.

kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.

56745.commentary: (VINa) saṅkhasevālapaṇakan'ti ettha saṅkho'ti dīghamūlako paṇṇasevālo vuccati. sevālo'ti nīlasevālo, avaseso udakapappaṭakatilabījak'ādi sabbo'pi paṇako'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

56746.meaning1: like the colour of a conch shell; bleached white

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ, aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni.

56747.meaning1: like the colour of a conch shell; bleached white

56748.meaning1: resembling the colour of a conch shell

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ, aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇ'ūpanibhāni… aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni… aṭṭhikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni. so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti.

56749.meaning1: goes by the name (of); is called; is defined (as); is reckoned (as); is classified (as)

examples.text: yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ anumīyati tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati. yaṃ n'ānuseti na taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ n'ānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti. aññātaṃ, bhagavā, aññātaṃ, sugatā'ti.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cattāro vaṇṇā, khattiyā, brāhmaṇā, vessā, suddā te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, samaṇā sakyaputtiyā tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti
saṅkham'pi na upeti upanidhim'pi na upeti kalabhāgam'pi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito'ti.
yatonidānaṃ bhikkhu purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti
ārogyaṃ samma'd'aññāya, āsavānaṃ parikkhayā, saṅkhāya sevī dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhaṃ n'opeti vedagū'ti.
yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ ahosī'ti tassa saṅkhā, ahosī'ti tassa samaññā, ahosī'ti tassa paññatti, na tassa saṅkhā atthī'ti, na tassa saṅkhā bhavissatī'ti.
ajito'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ saṅkhā samaññā paññatti vohāro nāmaṃ nāmakammaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ nirutti byañjanaṃ abhilāpo'ti, icc'āyasmā ajito.

56753.commentary: (MNa) saṅkhā'pī'ti evaṃ samaṇadhammassa anipphajjanabhāvaṃ jānitvā. anantaravāre pana saṅkhā'pī'ti evaṃ samaṇadhammassa nipphajjanabhāvaṃ jānitvā.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.
tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā saṅkhā'pi tamhā vanapatthā pakkamitabbaṃ, na vatthabbaṃ.

56755.meaning1: reckoned; so called; what is called; so named

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṅkhātaṃ taṃ jīvitahetu'pi na ajjhācarati. evaṃ kho, visākhe, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
adinn'ādāyī hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti

56756.commentary: (SNPa) saṅkhātadhammā'ti, anicc'ādi-vasena parivīmaṃsitadhammā, arahataṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (SNa) saṅkhātadhammassā'ti viditadhammassa tulitadhammassa.

examples.text: māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
ye ca saṅkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha, tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ, puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa.

56757.meaning1: considered to be more; reckoned more (something than)

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahu'd'eva aññathattaṃ ahu'd'eva domanassaṃ, yam'pi no imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhattānaṃ paṇītasaṅkhātataraṃ tassa'pi no bhagavā pahānam'āha, tassa'pi no sugato paṭinissaggam'āhā'ti.

atthi kho no, bhante, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti. katamo pana vo, thapatayo, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti?

56758.meaningLit: who has comprehended the nature of reality
56758.commentary: (SNPa) saṅkhātadhammā'ti, anicc'ādi-vasena parivīmaṃsitadhammā, arahataṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (SNa) saṅkhātadhammassā'ti viditadhammassa tulitadhammassa.

examples.text: māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
ye ca saṅkhātadhammāse, ye ca sekhā puthū idha, tesaṃ me nipako iriyaṃ, puṭṭho pabrūhi mārisa.

56759.meaning1: to calculate; to reckon; to enumerate

examples.text: te tādise pūjayato, nibbute akutobhaye, na sakkā puññaṃ saṅkhātuṃ, im'ettam'api kenaci.
te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi. tam'enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṅkhāditvā ajjhohari. tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi.

56764.commentary: (MNa) saṅkhāne'ti gaṇanāya. (MNa) saṅkhānan'ti piṇḍagaṇanā. yāya khettaṃ oloketvā idha ettakā vīhī bhavissanti, rukkhaṃ oloketvā idha ettakāni phalāni bhavissanti, ākāsaṃ oloketvā ime ākāse sakuṇā ettakā nāma bhavissantī'ti jānanti.

examples.text: amhākam'pi hi, bho gotama, gaṇakānaṃ gaṇan'ājīvānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, saṅkhāne.

idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.
saṅkhāya lokasmiṃ paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.
so saṅkhāya kulāni upasaṅkamati saṅkhāya nisīdati saṅkhāya dhammaṃ bhāsati saṅkhāya uccārapassāvaṃ sandhāreti

56767.commentary: (SNa) muddiko'ti aṅgulimuddāya gaṇanāya kusalo. saṅkhāyako'ti piṇḍagaṇanāya kusalo. (SNt) saṅkhāyako'ti saṅkalanapad'uppādan'ādi-piṇḍagaṇanāvasena gaṇako

examples.text: atthi pana te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti mahāsamudde udakaṃ gaṇetuṃ, ettakāni udak'āḷhakāni iti vā, ettakāni udak'āḷhakasatāni iti vā, ettakāni udak'āḷhakasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni udak'āḷhakasatasahassāni iti vāti? no h'etaṃ, ayye.

56768.meaning1: intention; volitional formation; choice; karmic activity

examples.text: avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ

te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, jarāsaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, maraṇasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsa-saṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti.
passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

yv'āyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅ'kato tassa kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni paribhinnāni.

56770.meaning1: mental formation; mental activity; thought processes; fourth of the five aggregates

examples.text: saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.

so phasso anicco'ti passati, vedanā aniccā'ti passati, saññā aniccā'ti passati, saṅkhārā aniccā'ti passati, viññāṇaṃ aniccan'ti passati. tassa dhāt'ārammaṇam'eva cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.

56771.meaning1: condition; conditioned thing; construction; fabrication; concoction

examples.text: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti, yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe, esa maggo visuddhiyā.
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.

56772.commentary: (VISMa) evaṃbhūtassa c'assa y'āyaṃ pubbe vaṇṇasampadā, gandhasampadā, abhisaṅkhārasampadā ca, sā ek'aṃsena vinassati, raso pana nasseyya vā na vā'ti āha antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso'ti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vicuṇṇitamakkhito taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso suvānadoṇiyaṃ ṭhitasuvānavamathu viya paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagacchati. evarūpo'pi samāno cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti evaṃ paribhogato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.

56774.meaning1: aggregate of mental activity; mass of volitional formations

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

56775.meaning1: related to mental activity; concerning intention; connected with volitional formation

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
viññāṇañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? viññāṇaṃ saṅkhāranidānaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ saṅkhārajātikaṃ saṅkhārapabhavaṃ.

56778.meaning1: supported by conditions; dependent on conditions

examples.text: sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. sabbe sattā saṅkhāraṭṭhitikā. ayaṃ kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena eko dhammo sammadakkhāto.

56779.commentary: (SNa) yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati

examples.text: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti
evam'eva kho, bho gotama… saṅkhār'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo saṅkhāresu patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati, viññāṇ'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo viññāṇe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavatī'ti.

56781.meaning2: suffering pain inseparable from mental formations

56782.meaning1: suffering inherent in conditions; dukkha of conditioned formations
56782.commentary: (DNa) saṅkhāradukkhatā'ti saṅkhārabhāvena dukkhatā. adukkham'asukhāvedanāy'etaṃ nāmaṃ. sā hi saṅkhatattā uppādajarābhaṅgapīḷitā, tasmā aññadukkhasabhāvavirahato saṅkhāradukkhatā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.

56783.meaning1: realm of mental activity; world of volitional formations

examples.text: saṅkhāradhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. saṅkhāradhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, okasārī hoti.
vedanādhātuyā… saññādhātuyā… saṅkhāradhātuyā ce bhikkhave… viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti, rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.

56784.meaning1: bound by desire to the realm of mental activity

examples.text: saṅkhāradhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. saṅkhāradhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ okasārī'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, okasārī hoti.

56785.meaning1: held in place and restrained by intention; intentionally managed and controlled
56785.commentary: (ANa) sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato'ti sasaṅkhārena sappayogena kilese niggaṇhitvā vāretvā vārito, na kilesānaṃ chinnante uppanno, kilese pana vāretvā uppanno.

examples.text: ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevito'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato, na saṅkhāraniggayhavāritagato'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati
viññāṇañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? viññāṇaṃ saṅkhāranidānaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ saṅkhārajātikaṃ saṅkhārapabhavaṃ.

56787.meaning1: ending of thought; cessation of intention; ending of mental fabrications

examples.text: phassasamudayā saṅkhārasamudayo, phassanirodhā saṅkhāranirodho.
saṅkhārasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā

56788.meaning1: path of practice leading to the end of intention

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

56789.meaning1: leading to the end of intention; leading to the cessation of thought processes

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako saṅkhāre ca pajānāti, saṅkhārasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhañ'ca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

56790.meaning1: suitable for leading to the ending of mental fabrications

examples.text: so saṅkhāre ca pajānāti, saṅkhārasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, saṅkhāranirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yā ca saṅkhāranirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañ'ca pajānāti, tathā paṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī

56791.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of saṅkhārapaccaya
56791.meaning1: dependent on intention; due to volition

examples.text: avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā
yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā

56792.meaning1: produced by volitional formations; generated by choice

examples.text: viññāṇañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? viññāṇaṃ saṅkhāranidānaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ saṅkhārajātikaṃ saṅkhārapabhavaṃ.

56793.meaning1: insight which fully grasps the mental formations

56794.meaning2: delimiting of mental formations (preparation for insight)

56795.meaning1: with intention as a support; established on thought processes

examples.text: vedan'upayaṃ… saññ'upayaṃ… saṅkhār'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

56796.meaning1: making an intentional effort; determined striving
56796.commentary: (MNt) saṅkhārappadhānā'ti sammasanapadena sukhen'eva khippataraṃ bhāvanā-ussukkāpana-vīriyaṃ dassitan'ti sukhāpaṭipadā khipp'ābhiññā dassitā.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti, imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hotī'ti.

56797.meaningLit: Discourse on the Analysis of Mental Formations

56798.commentary: (VINt) ubhaye'pi khandhā saṅkhāraloko paccayehi saṅkharīyanti lujjanti palujjanti cā'ti.

examples.text: apica tayo lokā, saṅkhāraloko, sattaloko, okāsaloko'ti, tattha eko loko, sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā'ti āgataṭṭhāne saṅkhāraloko veditabbo. sassato loko'ti vā asassato loko'ti vā'ti āgataṭṭhāne sattaloko.

56799.meaning1: freed by the extinguishing of mental fabrications; liberated through the dissolution of volitional formations

examples.text: saṅkhārasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.
